history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23: zoo owner, "Yeah do 1,2,3,4,5" (the five next experiments proposed after the current-state baseline of #695).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, after the full tier of reborn-perception-full (borg-zoo#736: rubble 5 deaths against ctl's 9, 8 rescued / 4 newly killed, DL5 reached 26 against 19) and the breadth-first and stair_scum results (#730, #721), before any result of this block was read. Four arms on 7bfbe121 (borg-reborn-rs PR #1128 on track-p d3d1629f, which ships stair_scum and breadth-first; the rubble switch is not on track-p): ctl (shipped); rubble (view_rubble_blocks_sight 1); bfs0 (explore_breadth_first 0); bfs0-rubble (both). Item 2 of the proposal (confirm the rubble lead on an unopened block) is ctl against rubble; item 5 (a combined candidates run) is bfs0-rubble against ctl, with bfs0 and rubble alone showing which part does the work. Pilot as the gate (ctl and rubble have had theirs on this build), then the ladder classes-1800 starts 1-900 (verysmall, small-rest, medium, big), read pooled. Primary: deaths, exact McNemar by start (rubble against ctl; bfs0-rubble against ctl; bfs0-rubble against bfs0), deaths at CL <= 2 apart; progress: DL3 and DL5 reached, mean CL, per class; the # Forgetting a monster notes are read from the pilot evidence.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, evidence retained.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Descriptive (RULES 14).
